description: This is a unit test class for the CatalogItemsSpecification in the ApplicationCore module of the eShopOnWeb project, testing filtering of catalog items based on specified IDs.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for CatalogItemsSpecification, verifying its behavior with various catalog item ID filters.

methods.name: MatchesSpecificCatalogItem
methods.description: Test that the specification correctly matches a single catalog item by ID.

methods.name: MatchesAllCatalogItems
methods.description: Test that the specification correctly matches multiple catalog items by their IDs.

methods.name: GetTestCollection
methods.description: Creates a list of mocked CatalogItem objects for testing purpose.
